answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 1100 aliases needs 1100 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The reef of the seal is the chip, the crystal of the quote is the receipt, and the forge of the heartbeat proves a live device, not a script.
